inclusion_rule: Include studies that recognize phones, words or sentences as text from ultrasound tongue images, with or without lip video, in silent or vocalized articulation, and report a recognition error or accuracy. Boundary: exclude ultrasound-to-speech synthesis without a recognition score, tongue contour tracking or clinical phonetics, reviews and surveys (counted in the pattern match but not as designs), and recognition from lips only; count versions once.
